blurb: Guests can take a 4-hour tour of the South Fox Lighthouse, explore the North Manitou Shoal Light "The Crib," or enjoy a customizable cruise on Lake Michigan with options to swim, picnic, or visit the Manitou Islands. The North Manitou Shoal Light is undergoing restoration and offers public tours. Trips depart from Fishtown in Leland.
